---
id: 2491
title: To George Huntingford
display-date: Feb 22 [?]
from-name: Charlotte Mary Yonge
from-address: Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.
to-name: To George Huntingford
manuscript-location: 'MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection C0171: Box 29'
---

My dear George Huntinford,[^1]
I hope you will come to luncheon here at one on Tuesday, Talbot from Mr Jeavon’s is I believe also coming I enclose a note for Mr Richardson.

No, I have written to [Dr Ridding](/person/1237)

Yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: Endorsed in pencil \'1874\'.
[^2]: The letter is evidently addressed to a schoolboy at Winchester College, but the most likely candidate, George Tremenheere Huntingford (1873-1939) did not attend the school until 1886, after George Ridding\'s departure.
